meta.name: Nepal Work Atlas Fresh Numeric Motion System
meta.description: A light-first Nepal labor-market intelligence interface where numbers lead, plain language explains them, and restrained motion preserves analytical continuity.
source_references: Nepal Work Atlas production data and evidence rules

color.palette_type: light neutral with restrained semantic accents

primary.role: primary quantitative emphasis and interactive state

accent.role: Nepal identity and critical evidence warnings only

neutral.usage: canvas, data surfaces, separators, secondary text and primary text

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant with WCAG AA text contrast and semantic colors always paired with text

font_families.heading: system-ui sans-serif
font_families.mono: SFMono-Regular, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: Neutral system sans with tabular numerals; monospace limited to IDs, URLs and machine-like provenance.

spacing.section_rhythm: 12-24px between analytical surfaces and 32-48px between major tasks

layout.grid_system: responsive analytical canvas with local 12-column data grids
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid with task-focused responsive collapse

border_radius.pill: reserved for compact status tracks only

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px neutral borders on analytical surfaces and controls

elevation.depth_cues: surface contrast, thin borders and restrained overlay shadow

iconography.style: minimal line SVG when icons are necessary
iconography.preferred_set: inline SVG or one consistent line-icon family; no emoji structural icons

motion.easing: power2.out for entrance, power2.inOut for state, power1.in for exit
motion.entrance_pattern: short 6-8px translation plus opacity, or path/value reveal for data
motion.exit_pattern: shorter opacity/translation at roughly 60-70 percent of entrance time
motion.philosophy: corporate functional continuity with higher motion density but no decorative loops

components.button_style: 44px minimum controls with 8px radius, clear pressed feedback near scale 0.985 and data-blue primary action
components.input_style: white 1px bordered controls with explicit labels and visible blue focus ring
components.card_style: white 8-12px analytical surfaces with subtle borders and very light elevation
components.navigation_pattern: Employment, Jobs and Research primary tabs with gliding active indicator; Jobs has Jobs, Map, History and Sources secondary tabs
components.modal_style: inline or sticky side inspector with slide/fade continuity rather than centered modal
components.list_style: dense evidence tables and responsive row cards with tabular numbers
components.component_notes: Important metrics always use number, plain-English label, source/detail order. Opportunity Landscape exploration is local until Apply to dashboard is used.

visual_language.complexity: moderate data density with simple chrome
visual_language.whitespace_usage: compact inside data regions with clear breathing room between tasks
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: large numbers lead, charts and tables support, provenance follows

composition.hierarchy_method: numeric scale, typographic hierarchy, surface grouping and spatial isolation
composition.flow_direction: workspace selection followed by number-to-detail reading order
composition.grouping_strategy: white surfaces, thin rules, shared alignment and local tabs
composition.negative_space_role: keeps dense evidence readable and separates exploration from applied filtering

imagery.graphic_elements: treemap rectangles, province bars, history line, source bars and numeric panels

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: border and surface emphasis without data-distorting scale
interaction_feel.loading_style: neutral skeleton shimmer only while loading

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: state what is missing and preserve unknown instead of implying zero

overview.fallback_strategy: remove number counting, stagger and large spatial motion; render stable final states immediately
overview.primary_technology: GSAP core + Flip + CSS + accessible SVG

background_effects.description: solid neutral canvas and white analytical surfaces

3d_elements.description: Three.js is intentionally excluded from core Employment, Jobs, Map, History, Sources and Research workspaces

shader_effects.description: no shader effects in analytical workspaces

scroll_morphing.description: workspaces use state continuity rather than scroll choreography

text_effects.description: headline numeric values interpolate on meaningful state changes; ordinary text never animates continuously

image_effects.description: no decorative imagery in analytical workspaces

params.blur_radius: 0 except sticky header backdrop for legibility

canvas_drawings.description: DOM and SVG data visuals preserve keyboard access and text fallbacks

svg_animations.description: History line reveals once when the view becomes active

params.stroke_animation: dashoffset from full path length to zero in about 380ms

visual_effects.composite_notes: GSAP is used for navigation indicators, number transitions, workspace continuity, list refresh, job inspector, Opportunity Landscape state changes, province/source bars, source reordering and research evidence. Motion is interruptible and reduced-motion removes counting, stagger and large spatial movement. Three.js remains outside the core product dependency set.
